Can you tell me about the History?
The Nunavut Land Claims Agreement Act and the Nunavut Act were passed by the Canadian Parliament on July 9, 1993.
Thank you, do you have any other information you can give me about the history of Nunavut?
The population has spurted from 5,200 in 2001 to 6,600 in 2011, which is a 27% increase since the Nunavut was created.
Interesting, do you have any information about the Demographics of Nunavut?
In the 2016 census, there was 30,125 Inuit people in Nunavut and 90.7% could speak either Inuktitut or Inuinnaqtun report says.
Do you have anymore information you could provide me about the demographics?
Inuit is the official language as well as English and French!
Cool, I didn't know that. Thanks for all your help.
You're very welcome!
Hello, I'd like to be educated about Colombia please.
I would be happy to help. Columbia is a big country in South America. Would you like to learn more about its geography?
Yes, please tell me about the geography.

About 10% of the species on earth live in Columbia! including over 1.900 species of bird, more than Europe and North America combined. Columbia also has 10% of the world's mammal species, 14% of the amphibian, and 18% of the bird species of the world.
Wow, that's amazing. Any other fascinating geography facts you can share?

The geography of Columbia is characterized by its six natural regions that present unique characteristics. The Andes mountain range that is shared with Ecuador and Venezuela, the Pacific coastal region, shared with Panama and Ecuador, the Caribbean coastal region, shared with Venezuela; the Amazon Rainforest region shared with Venezuela, Brazil, Peru, and Ecuador; the Llanos (plains) shared with Venezuela; and the insular area which comprises of islands in both the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.
Sounds like a very exotic place with all those different regions. Before we move on to the topic of politics, I'd like to learn more geography facts.
Sure, Columbia has four major drainage systems; the Pacific drain, the Caribbean drain, the Orinoco Basin, and the Amazon Basin.
Thank you for that interesting fact. Unless there are more interesting geography facts, I'd like to learn two facts about government and politics please.
I don't have any information about government and politics at this time. I will share that the principal port in Columbia is Buenaventura.
Thank you for that. If you can share one final fact please. Geography or government and politics is fine.
The legislative branch of government is represented nationally by the Congress. A bicameral institution comprising a 166 seat Chamber of Representatives and a 102 seat Senate.
Thank you for all the excellent facts. I am much more educated about Colombia now thanks to your help. Have a good day!
You as well!
